description: Trophy case is a cabinet you can look into and fail to take. Canonical treasure deposit stays.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE TROPHY-CASE-FCN ()
    <COND (<AND <VERB? TAKE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,TROPHY-CASE>>
	   <TELL
"The trophy case is securely fastened to the wall." CR>)>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE TROPHY-CASE-FCN ()
    <COND (<AND <VERB? TAKE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,TROPHY-CASE>>
	   <TELL
"The trophy case is securely fastened to the wall. It is a cabinet, not a score panel." CR>)
	  (<VERB? EXAMINE>
	   <TELL "The trophy case is a real wall cabinet. Treasures go in; it is not a score interface." CR>)>>
